arxiv-2011-10374.title: Lepton Anomalous Magnetic Moments in an S 4 S_{4} Flavor-Symmetric Extra U(1) Model
arxiv-2011-10374.creator: Yasuhiro Daikoku, Hiroshi Okada
arxiv-2011-10374.description: Abstract We study supersymmetric extra U(1) model with S 4 S_{4} flavor symmetry. The flavor symmetry not only stabilizes proton but also suppresses the flavor changing processes without raising the supersymmetry breaking scale. After the flavor symmetry is broken, the Yukawa hierarchy is realized by the Froggatt-Nielsen mechanism.

arxiv-2210-08112.title: Stress percolation criticality of glass to fluid transition in active cell layers
arxiv-2210-08112.creator: Siavash Monfared, Guruswami Ravichandran, José E. Andrade, Amin Doostmohammadi
arxiv-2210-08112.description: Abstract Using three-dimensional representation of confluent cell layers, we map the amorphous solid to fluid phase transition in active cell layers onto the two-dimensional (2D) site percolation universality class. Importantly, we unify two distinct, predominant, pathways associated with this transition; namely (i) cell-cell adhesion and (ii) active traction forces.

arxiv-2212-05463.title: Vision Transformer with Attentive Pooling for Robust Facial Expression Recognition
arxiv-2212-05463.creator: Fanglei Xue, Qiangchang Wang, Zichang Tan, Zhongsong Ma, and Guodong Guo
arxiv-2212-05463.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Fanglei Xue, Qiangchang Wang, Zichang Tan, Zhongsong Ma, and Guodong Guo. Facial Expression Recognition (FER) in the wild is an extremely challenging task. Recently, some Vision Transformers (ViT) have been explored for FER, but most of them perform inferiorly compared to Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN). This is mainly because the new proposed modules are difficult to converge well from scratch due to lacking inductive bias and easy to focus on the occlusion and noisy areas.

arxiv-2308-14999.description: Abstract With their shielded 4f orbitals, rare-earth ions (REIs) offer optical and electron spin transitions with good coherence properties even when embedded in a host crystal matrix, highlighting their utility as promising quantum emitters and memories for quantum information processing.

arxiv-2405-19525.title: Lifelong Learning Using a Dynamically Growing Tree of Sub-networks for Domain Generalization in Video Object Segmentation
arxiv-2405-19525.creator: Islam Osman, Mohamed S. Shehata
arxiv-2405-19525.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Islam Osman, Mohamed S. Shehata. Current state-of-the-art video object segmentation models have achieved great success using supervised learning with massive labeled training datasets. However, these models are trained using a single source domain and evaluated using videos sampled from the same source domain. When these models are evaluated using videos sampled from a different target domain, their performance degrades significantly due to poor domain generalization, i.e., their inability to learn from multi-domain sources simultaneously using traditional supervised learning.

arxiv-2408-04456.title: Modeling diffusion in networks with communities: a multitype branching process approach
arxiv-2408-04456.creator: Alina Dubovskaya, Caroline B. Pena, David J.P. O’Sullivan
arxiv-2408-04456.description: Abstract The dynamics of diffusion in complex networks are widely studied to understand how entities, such as information, diseases, or behaviors, spread in an interconnected environment. Complex networks often present community structure, and tools to analyze diffusion processes on networks with communities are needed.

arxiv-2602-04030.title: TiCLS : Tightly Coupled Language Text Spotter
arxiv-2602-04030.creator: Leeje Jang, Yijun Lin, Yao-Yi Chiang, Jerod Weinman
arxiv-2602-04030.description: Abstract Scene text spotting aims to detect and recognize text in real-world images, where instances are often short, fragmented, or visually ambiguous. Existing methods primarily rely on visual cues and implicitly capture local character dependencies, but they overlook the benefits of external linguistic knowledge.

arxiv-2602-18079.title: Dynamic Deception: When Pedestrians Team Up to Fool Autonomous Cars
arxiv-2602-18079.creator: Masoud Jamshidiyan Tehrani, Marco Gabriel, Jinhan Kim, Paolo Tonella
arxiv-2602-18079.description: Abstract Many adversarial attacks on autonomous-driving perception models fail to cause system-level failures once deployed in a full driving stack. The main reason for such ineffectiveness is that once deployed in a system (e.g., within a simulator), attacks tend to be spatially or temporally short-lived, due to the vehicle’s dynamics, hence rarely influencing the vehicle behaviour.

arxiv-2602-22683.title: SuperGlasses : Benchmarking Vision Language Models as Intelligent Agents for AI Smart Glasses
arxiv-2602-22683.creator: Zhuohang Jiang, Xu Yuan, Haohao Qu, Shanru Lin, Kanglong Liu, Wenqi Fan, Qing Li, [0.1cm] The Hong Kong Polytechnic University City University of Hong Kong

pmc-11652100.title: Handmade snare-assisted endoscope tip-bending angulation booster
pmc-11652100.creator: Haruhiro Inoue, Marc Julius Navarro, Kei Ushikubo, Yoshiaki Kimoto, Kazuki Yamamoto, Yohei Nishikawa, Manabu Onimaru, Yuto Shimamura
pmc-11652100.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Video Background Endoscopic interventions require accurate and precise control of the endoscope tip. Flexible endoscopy depends heavily on steering the endoscope tip in the desired direction. Control depends on pull wires attached at the tip just beneath its outer protective sheath and passing back through the length of the instrument shaft to the 2 angulation control wheels (for up/down and right/left movement).

pmc-12510081.creator: Wenyan Li, Claes Dahlgren, Huamei Forsman
pmc-12510081.description: Regulation of the reactive oxygen species (ROS) producing NADPH oxidase, expressed in neutrophils, is essential for a balance between the proinflammatory antimicrobial host defence and the resolving reactivity that limits tissue destructing inflammatory processes. Peripheral blood neutrophils of healthy adults were isolated from buffy coats obtained from the blood bank at Sahlgrenska University Hospital, using a standard density-gradient centrifugation protocol.

pmc-12609370.title: Development of an Adapted Version of the Motor Competence Assessment (MCA) for Older Adults
pmc-12609370.creator: Bruno Silva, Luís Paulo Rodrigues, Pedro Bezerra, José Maria Cancela Carral, Darren Warburton
pmc-12609370.description: Background/Objectives: Age-related declines in motor and functional abilities can compromise independence and quality of life in later life. Motor competence (MC) plays an important role in maintaining quality of life and independence. However, few reliable instruments exist to assess MC in this population.

pmc-12701571.title: A novel SlSTOP1–SlHAK5–cytosolic pH feedback loop drives dual adaptation to proton and aluminum toxicity in tomato
pmc-12701571.creator: Huihui Zhu, Yuzhi Bai, Liqiong Jia, Lijie Jia, Feifei Liang, Chao Li, Zheng-An Yang, Wei Fan, Jianli Yang
pmc-12701571.description: Plants often experience aluminum (Al) toxicity in acidic soils, where the transcription factor SENSITIVE TO PROTON RHIZOTOXICITY1 (STOP1) plays a pivotal role in regulating transcriptional responses to Al stress. While posttranscriptional regulation of STOP1 under Al toxicity has been extensively studied, the mechanisms linking Al stress signals to STOP1 protein stability remain unclear.

pmc-12844322.title: Rehabilitation Nursing Care for Older Adults with Impaired Fine Motor Function: From Design to Validation
pmc-12844322.creator: Magda Rafaela Carneiro Freitas, Ana da Conceição Alves Faria, Carla Gomes da Rocha, Maria Narcisa da Costa Gonçalves, Olga Maria Pimenta Lopes Ribeiro
pmc-12844322.description: Background: Population ageing and the growing prevalence of chronic diseases, particularly stroke, have negative repercussions on fine motor function, compromising the independence of older adults. The Specialist Nurse in Rehabilitation Nursing plays a central role in functional recovery and in improving quality of life.

pmc-12968073.creator: Abiba Alhassan Khalifah, Stephen Twumasi, Allwell Adofo Ayirebi, Wina Ivy Ofori Boadu, Francis Agyei Amponsah, Joseph Frimpong, David Amoah Afrifah, Ernest Appiagyei, Albert Ntim Boadu, Daniel Nii Martey Antonio, Enoch Odame Anto
pmc-12968073.description: BackgroundViral hepatitis has been associated with profound alterations in the coagulation system as well as liver biomarkers. Meanwhile, during pregnancy, the coagulation system also undergoes significant changes with an increase in the majority of the clotting factors and a decrease in natural anticoagulants.

pmc-13072649.title: The efficacy and safety of MSCs in GVHD prevention and the treatment of SR-aGVHD: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
pmc-13072649.creator: Shuzhou Wu, Wenming Lu, An Xie, Jiabing Wang, Wenhui Zeng, Cixiang Chen, Nan Wu, Junsong Ye, Zhengwei Zou, Lincai Li, Lin Zhou
pmc-13072649.description: BackgroundHematopoietic stem cell transplantation (HSCT) is a cornerstone in the treatment of hematological disorders. However, its application is frequently complicated by acute and chronic graft-versus-host disease (aGVHD/cGVHD), pathological conditions in which donor-derived immune cells attack host tissues. With suboptimal survival rates and limited therapeutic options, GVHD remains a major clinical challenge.

pmc-13212599.title: Malignant vs. Non-malignant Annotations on TCGA Breast Cancer Whole Slide Images for AI Analysis
pmc-13212599.creator: Zahra Alidousti Shahraki, Otto Jokelainen, Mari Valkonen, Päivi Auvinen, Arto Mannermaa, Hamid Behravan
pmc-13212599.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Identification of malignant and non-malignant regions in breast cancer whole slide images (WSIs) is essential for understanding tumor heterogeneity and histopathological evaluation. Annotated data allows deep learning models to learn features and analyze histological structures. In this study, we obtained 50 breast cancer WSIs from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) and had an expert pathologist manually annotate malignant (n = 1,882) and non-malignant (n = 374) regions using QuPath.

pmc-13301974.description: BackgroundPowered radiofrequency (RF) guidewires are increasingly used for transseptal puncture (TSP) in procedures that require left atrial (LA) access. pmc-13395962.creator: Mohamed J Saadh, Faris Anad Muhammad, Rafid Jihad Albadr, Vimal Arora, Subbulakshmi Ganesan, Aman Shankhyan, Ajay Sharma, Jasur Rizaev, Waam Mohammed Taher, Mariem Alwan, Mahmood Jasem Jawad, Ali M Ali Al-Nuaimi
